WITH store_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 1998 AND sale_type = 's'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
),
store_1999 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 1999 AND sale_type = 's'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
),
web_1998 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 1998 AND sale_type = 'w'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
),
web_1999 AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 1999 AND sale_type = 'w'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
)
SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM 
    store_1998 t_s_firstyear
JOIN 
    store_1999 t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    web_1998 t_w_firstyear ON t_w_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    web_1999 t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
WHERE 
    t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total > t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total
ORDER BY 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
